title: Add AIOPE Headless to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [AIOPE Headless](https://xnet.ngo) to build
- Self-hosted AI assistant server with web UI, tool execution, and Pollinations.ai as primary LLM and image generation provider. Features include: web search, SSH management, file operations, SVG raster

Fixes #11123

gist.headline: A greenhouse with tools
gist.blurb: AIOPE Headless joined the build: a self-hosted assistant that can search the web, tend files, manage SSH, and turn SVGs into pixels. Pollinations supplies the thoughts and pictures; the little server does the chores.
gist.summary: Added AIOPE Headless to the app catalog, a self-hosted AI assistant server with a web UI, tool execution, web search, SSH management, file operations, SVG rasterization, and Pollinations.ai as its primary text and image provider.
gist.impact: Developers can discover and run a self-hosted assistant that combines Pollinations generation with practical tools for searching, managing servers, handling files, and rendering SVGs.
gist.visual_concept: Depict AIOPE Headless as a cozy garden-shed assistant server: a retro terminal sprouts tool-shaped code-plants for web search, SSH keys, files, and SVG-to-image conversion. Polli, wearing a tiny tool belt, warmly helps a friendly CRT monitor robot tend the server garden, making Pollinations visibly the source of glowing text and image pollen.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of a self-hosted assistant garden shed where a friendly CRT monitor robot tends code-plants shaped like a magnifying glass, SSH key, file folder, and tiny SVG canvas, all growing from prominent lime green (#ecf874) pots; Polli is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and rounded light-blue translucent wings, wearing a tiny tool belt as she helps water the glowing terminal garden. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley, with subtle pixel-font text reading “AIOPE HEADLESS”; nostalgic, friendly, and emotionally warm.
